author: papagoogs
body:
Hello, I’d like to appeal my infraction for “Ban Evading”
First of all, I would like to point out that in the original scenario, my account okgooglelmao hadn’t logged onto Avicus until months after jackhulk1 had been banned for hacks. (I believe it was somewhere around 6 months). Now, I don’t think any ban evader would be patient enough to wait for that long. That conversation I had with AutoTool although I don’t remember it, I don’t deny it. In the video, yes, I did claim to be my neighbor, but that was only because there was no other way to prove my innocence. I haven’t really talked to my neighbor ever since that time he came over to my house and played Avicus and got banned. Things haven’t really been the best between us since then and that’s why I used recording myself claiming to be my neighbor as a last resort. I told the truth in my first appeal, but that didn’t get me anywhere. They say that “honesty is the best policy”, yet that got me nowhere in my first appeal. Then I had to add the video recording of myself because it would be hard to deny someone’s appeal after seeing that. 
I understand that it’s hard to believe me, but that is because there is almost no way to prove my innocence. I mean like if you have a reasonable way for me to prove that I wasn’t ban evading, just tell me and I’ll do it. 
Thank you for your time.
-Google

title: Appeal

replies.author: papagoogs
replies.body:
Hello, 

I've been waiting patiently for over a week now and still haven't got a reply for an incident that was solved months ago. There are over 30 views on my appeal. Surely somebody has the time and it shouldn't take longer than a week. If you are going to take this long, at least tell me you are going to need more time, because nobody should have to wait for a week without any response at all. Please respond soon. 

Thank you in advance.
-Google

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
"Hello Sessp.

I admit to sending these messages to AutoTool and my terrible actions. I dearly apologise for everything i've done and i'd like to thank you for doing your job. I am sorry for lying to you Posighdun and all i want is one last chance. I love my team and everything but i got kicked for something stupid that I did. I got kicked from the people I love, just for this one stupid thing I did. You don't need to appeal this Sessp. My life here has been ruined. I am just very deeply sorry. I'm crying right now writing this, all i want is just one more chance. Please... I just don't want to be seperated from cacal, they are my blood Sessp. Just please give me one last chance."

If honestly is the best policy then you haven't really been upholding it....

Denied.
